note: The continent: one landmass surrounded by impassable ocean. Towns are authored (data/towns/*.json); everything else is generated from the seed. Roads connect every pair of towns.
note_villages: 0.3.1 small villages between the cities (data/towns/<id>.json, kind village; data/villages.json). Not cities: distance bands, travel, markets and respawn use towns only.

road_rules.note: 0.3.1 A* road costs per tile: land 1, dirt/sand/marsh multipliers, lake water = bridge_cost per tile (a wooden bridge; ocean is never crossed). meander = moisture-noise cost wobble so roads curve. pk_cost keeps roads out of the Scorch. margin = search box around the two towns. max_bridge = longest allowed span (selftest).
